translations.translatedText: # Monday 6.6.2022 (radio)
Municipal sector. Russian speakers in Finland. Electric car charging stations. Travel at the eastern border. The weather.
## Municipal sector negotiation result
![Strikers at the parade square in Jyväskylä.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3408,h_1917,x_0,y_50/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-95018462725d0a191a4/1651662603)
Open image viewer
Municipal sector workers demonstrated in May. Photo: Niko Mannonen / Yle

The municipal sector negotiations have succeeded. The municipal sector trade unions have settled the disputes with the employer. There has been a dispute in the municipal sector about wages, for example.
The municipal sector negotiations began already in January. The negotiations have concerned more than 420 000 municipal sector workers, for example teachers and bus drivers.
Next, the trade unions of different sectors will deal with the negotiation result. If they accept the negotiation result, the municipal sector disputes are officially over.
The negotiation result does not, however, cover the health care sector. The negotiations of nurses continue later.
## Russian speakers in Finland
![People walking on a street.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4989,h_2800,x_0,y_104/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-932913623c82381688f/1648356318)
Open image viewer
Russian speakers are Finland's largest foreign-language group. Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle
Russian-speaking residents of Finland do not often face racism. A Yle survey says that 80 per cent of Russian-speaking residents of Finland have not encountered racism.
However, 30 per cent of Russian speakers say that the treatment of Russian speakers has got worse because of the war in Ukraine. Russia started the war in Ukraine in February.
The survey included 500 Russian speakers who live in Finland.
## Electric car charging stations

![K-charging director Tom von Bonsdorff at a charging point.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_445/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7979506081943676c8e/1619104948)
Open image viewer
There are many new charging stations. Photo: Lotta Laakso / Yle
Many new electric car charging stations are being built in Finland. This summer several hundred new high-power charging stations will be built.

Charging stations are being built especially by the big retail chains, that is, the S Group and the K Group. The K Group says that motorists charged electricity at its stations for millions of driving kilometres during the early part of the year.
Electric cars interest motorists, because the price of petrol has risen a lot.
## Travel at the eastern border

![Quiet at the departure lanes of the Nuijamaa border station.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3848,h_2165,x_0,y_289/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-842828611b985384883/1629199006)
Open image viewer
Nuijamaa border station in Lappeenranta. Photo: Mikko Savolainen / Yle
Many travellers have not been able to get from Russia to Finland this year. Usually the reason is that the travellers have not met the corona requirements.
The number of cases has grown during the spring. For example, in May Finland's border authorities prevented about 300 travellers from crossing Finland's eastern border.

The border between Finland and Russia was completely closed for more than 2 years because of corona. Now there are restrictions at the border because of corona, which are in force at least until the end of June.
## The weather
![weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12479089)
Open image viewer
On Tuesday the sun shines in the southern and central parts of the country. In the north it is cloudier, and in Eastern Lapland light rain falls at times.
The temperature in the southern and central parts of the country is between 20 and 23 degrees, and in Lapland between 10 and 20 degrees.
On Wednesday rain arrives in the south and the weather cools. In the rainy areas of the south the temperature is 15 degrees on Wednesday.
